input: Volunteer at a local soup kitchen this weekend

gold.taskTitle: Volunteer at a local soup kitchen this weekend
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to find and sign up to volunteer at a nearby soup kitchen during the upcoming weekend.

questions.title: Which city or neighborhood are you located in?
questions.description: Identifies the user's location to find relevant local soup kitchens nearby.

questions.title: Have you volunteered at a soup kitchen before?
questions.description: Determines the user's prior experience to tailor preparation advice and expectations.

questions.title: Do you have a specific day in mind, Saturday or Sunday?
questions.description: Narrows down availability to one specific day within the weekend.

questions.title: How many hours are you available to volunteer?
questions.description: Clarifies the time commitment the user can offer, such as a few hours or a full day.

questions.title: Are you volunteering alone or with a group?
questions.description: Determines whether this is a solo effort or requires coordinating multiple people.

questions.title: Do you have any physical limitations or dietary restrictions to flag?
questions.description: Identifies any constraints that could affect the type of volunteer role the user can take on.

questions.title: Do you already have a specific soup kitchen in mind?
questions.description: Checks whether the user needs help finding a venue or has already identified one.
